ci_summary.title: CI summary
ci_summary.description: Unformatted columns for machine consumption. Rendered with --output=json and turned into markdown by .github/workflows/pr.yml; the JSON renderer drops any column that does not evaluate to a scalar, so keep these expressions free of display units (`as time`, `as memory`) and let the consumer format them.

ci_compare.title: CI baseline comparison
ci_compare.description: The ci_summary columns paired with the stored baseline's, for --output=json. Only a `run --ref=<tag>` populates the baseline_* values: the generator reads one suite (`firstOnly`), so rendering this from a dumped XML yields "ERR" in every baseline column. The current-value expressions are repeated verbatim under baseline_expressions to *suppress* the generator's own defaults, which otherwise replace `mode`, `mem_peak` and `rstdev` with a display string pairing the baseline value and a percent difference -- readable in a console, useless to a JSON consumer.
